intro: This investigation into Stalvan Mistmantle leads out of Duskwood to an isolated home in southeastern Elwynn Forest. Marshal Haggard, an aging veteran whose eyesight has deteriorated, directs you to an upstairs chest containing an old bundle of papers left behind when he moved in.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: There was a bundle of parchments in the chest upstairs when I moved into this place. I looked at them once when I first arrived but I gave up once the fog hazed over my peepers.

Do an old, nearly-blind man a favor and check the chest upstairs for anything that might help you in your quest to discover more about this Stalvan character. I'm pretty sure there's a faded journal page that might be of interest to you. Bring it to me and I'll help in anyway I can.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Did you find that page I mentioned, friend?
